mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS playlistId, p.title AS title, p.cover_url AS coverUrl, p.introduction AS introduction, p.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, p.is_public AS isPublic, p.style AS style, p.status AS status, p.cover_is_custom AS coverIsCustom, pb.song_id AS songId, s.name AS songName, s.album_id AS albumId, s.album AS album, s.duration AS duration, s.cover_url AS songCoverUrl, s.audio_url AS audioUrl, s.release_time AS releaseTime, s.artist_names AS artistName, c.id AS commentId, c.content AS content, c.create_time AS createTime, c.like_count AS likeCount, u.username AS username, u.user_avatar AS userAvatar FROM tb_playlist p LEFT JOIN tb_playlist_binding pb ON p.id = pb.playlist_id LEFT JOIN tb_song s ON pb.song_id = s.id LEFT JOIN tb_comment c ON p.id = c.playlist_id AND c.type = 1 LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON c.user_id = u.id
mapper.select: WHERE p.id = #{playlistId} ORDER BY pb.song_id, c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT style FROM tb_playlist WHERE is_public = 1 AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'PUBLISHED') AND id IN
#{id}

SELECT p.id AS playlistId, p.title AS title, p.cover_url AS coverUrl FROM tb_playlist p LEFT JOIN tb_user_favorite u ON p.id = u.playlist_id AND u.user_id = #{userId} WHERE (p.is_public = 1 AND (p.status IS NULL OR p.status = 'PUBLISHED') OR p.owner_user_id = #{userId})
AND p.id IN #{id}
AND 1 = 0
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND p.style LIKE CONCAT('%', #{style}, '%')
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id AS playlistId, p.title, p.cover_url AS coverUrl, p.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, p.is_public AS isPublic, p.introduction, p.style, p.status, p.cover_is_custom AS coverIsCustom, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_playlist_binding b WHERE b.playlist_id = p.id) AS songCount FROM tb_playlist p WHERE p.owner_user_id = #{ownerId} AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%') AND p.style = #{style} ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT p.id AS playlistId, p.title, p.cover_url AS coverUrl, p.introduction, p.style, p.is_public AS isPublic, p.status, p.cover_is_custom AS coverIsCustom, p.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, u.username AS ownerName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_playlist_binding b WHERE b.playlist_id = p.id) AS songCount FROM tb_playlist p LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = p.owner_user_id
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%') AND p.style LIKE CONCAT('%', #{style}, '%') AND p.status = #{status} AND p.owner_user_id IS NULL AND p.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT p.id AS playlistId, p.title, p.cover_url AS coverUrl, p.introduction, p.style, p.is_public AS isPublic, p.status, p.cover_is_custom AS coverIsCustom, p.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_playlist_binding b WHERE b.playlist_id = p.id) AS songCount, CASE WHEN #{viewerId} IS NOT NULL AND p.owner_user_id = #{viewerId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS owned, CASE WHEN #{viewerId} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_user_favorite f WHERE f.user_id = #{viewerId} AND f.type = 1 AND f.playlist_id = p.id ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS favorite FROM tb_playlist p WHERE p.is_public = 1 AND (p.status IS NULL OR p.status = 'PUBLISHED') AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%') AND p.style = #{style} ORDER BY owned ASC, p.id DESC
